name: Retro Windows
avoid_for: Decks that need to read as modern, elegant, or institutionally credible — the Win95 chrome will always read as a costume
weak_cases: Tiny controls and dense chrome are risky in projected decks; decorative controls must not imply working interaction.
visual_signature: Raised/sunken bevels, white content wells, gray chrome and active-window hierarchy.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Native UI fonts vary by platform; pixel accent faces may lack needed glyphs and must be tested.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
